title: Resolution urging Albany to require licensing of commercial e-bikes
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass S.7587/A.7833, the "Commercial E-Bike Licensing Act." The bill would require registration of e-bikes used for commercial purposes, such as food delivery, and would place liability for certain violations, including sidewalk riding, on employers rather than workers. It responds to concerns about e-bike safety, noting that pedal e-bikes were linked to nine deaths in 2022 and 12 in 2023 in New York City.
